simulation_metadata.title: Review Detector Sensitivity Sweep
simulation_metadata.decisive_m2_indices_selection_rule: samples exactly k_m3 cases without replacement from decisive M2 cases (where d_m2 != 'Unresolved')
simulation_metadata.proximity_tie_rule: Python stable sort by distance to threshold (preserving earlier trial indices on exact ties)
simulation_metadata.disclaimer: Evaluates operational mechanics of an assumed generic review gate under stated mathematical parameters, not human MESA review performance.
